# Apollon — World Intelligence Dashboard

> Apollon aggregates world news from hundreds of public RSS feeds, summarises each article with AI, places it on a live map, and publishes one AI-written daily report per day (Athens time) in English and Greek. Reports cite and link their original sources.

## Daily reports

- [Daily reports (English)](https://apollon.talosat.work/reports): archive of daily world news briefings, newest first
- [Ημερήσιες αναφορές (Greek)](https://apollon.talosat.work/el/reports): the same reports in Greek
- [Latest report](https://apollon.talosat.work/reports/latest)
- [RSS feed](https://apollon.talosat.work/reports/rss.xml)

## Regions

- [Europe](https://apollon.talosat.work/reports/region/europe)
- [Balkans](https://apollon.talosat.work/reports/region/balkans)
- [Mediterranean](https://apollon.talosat.work/reports/region/mediterranean)
- [Eastern Mediterranean](https://apollon.talosat.work/reports/region/east-med)

## Optional

- [Live map](https://apollon.talosat.work/): interactive dashboard (JavaScript app)
- [Sitemap](https://apollon.talosat.work/sitemap.xml)
